import ctypes
import math

def gsl_log1p_py(x):
    # Load libraries with correct order and global resolution for BLAS symbols
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Define the function prototype
    gsl.gsl_log1p.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_log1p.restype = ctypes.c_double
    
    # Call the C function and return result
    return gsl.gsl_log1p(x)

def assert_test():
    # Test with x = 0 (log(1+0) = 0)
    assert math.isclose(gsl_log1p_py(0.0), 0.0, abs_tol=1e-10)
    
    # Test with positive x (log(1+2.5))
    expected = math.log1p(2.5)
    assert math.isclose(gsl_log1p_py(2.5), expected, abs_tol=1e-10)
    
    # Test with negative x within domain (log(1-0.5))
    expected = math.log1p(-0.5)
    assert math.isclose(gsl_log1p_py(-0.5), expected, abs_tol=1e-10)
    
    # Test with very small x (accuracy test)
    x = 1e-15
    expected = math.log1p(x)
    assert math.isclose(gsl_log1p_py(x), expected, abs_tol=1e-10)
    
    # Test with large x
    x = 1e6
    expected = math.log1p(x)
    assert math.isclose(gsl_log1p_py(x), expected, abs_tol=1e-10)
    
    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
